source.intent: Native ATTACK branch lowers weak stance prone above0.9 suppression; CBE retains useful low-profile response but protects committed movement and exact restoration. No upstream dependency or raw imported implementation.

finding: CBE ENGAGE only lowered standing actors to MIDDLE above0.2; idle crouched actors at extreme suppression could not lower further without a separate immediate event.
implementation: ENGAGE suppression>0.9 and not committed mover requests DOWN; moderate suppression retains STAND->MIDDLE. Existing weak stance ownership/expiry/interruption/restoration unchanged. Native suppression sampled once per response across branches. No native movement/fire command, worker, timer or new setting.
validation: 1491 existing tests/full HEMTT/FSM/SQF/config/docs/package and independent copied-package verification passed; existing mobile-posture and observation regressions extended, no new cases. Initial gate failed old direct getSuppression spelling after sample reuse; revised assertion preserves0.45 threshold and checks sample producer; reviewed build passed.
limits: Unsigned dirty development snapshot retaining unrelated dirt; notes afterward. Physical native suppression/posture/mobility/restoration, tactical balance and performance unverified. No tracker score/hash renewal. Audits paused.

nativeBurstContinuationFollowup.engineEvidence: Native burst uses an engine-selected number of rounds and exposes currentCommand Suppress. A fixed CBE timestamp does not establish burst completion.
nativeBurstContinuationFollowup.fixed: CBE previously counted only LastSuppress newer than eight seconds. An ongoing native burst beyond that window no longer disappeared from the configured active-suppressor budget. Existing native SUPPRESS actors are also rejected before reserve/geometry discovery for another burst. Native bursts issued outside CBE count within the existing eligible stationary member roster.
nativeBurstContinuationFollowup.integration: Existing three-lane geometry bound, group randomized spacing, eight-second request/rest window, loaded primary bullet muzzle, reserve requirements, target belief, current medical/Zeus/native task and friendly-cone checks retained. No movement, additional worker, burst cancel or new timer.
nativeBurstContinuationFollowup.limits: Command observation is not shot acknowledgement or effective suppression. It does not count unavailable actors outside the existing eligible member roster or establish full LAMBS fire-control parity. Native burst spacing/ammo/balance/performance remain physically unverified; audits paused.
